name: leash_task_start
description: Initialize a secure mission environment. Returns a Task ID.

name: leash_install_package
description: Request installation of a python package into the current task.

name: leash_exec_secure
description: Execute a command with injected secrets. Secrets are placed in the environment and NOT visible to the LLM.

name: leash_get_task_path
description: Get the task environment PATH for direct command execution. Use with: eval $(openleash run --task-id {task_id})

name: leash_task_end
description: Terminate the task and cleanup all isolated resources.
